pages.text: Under the ground there are catacombs, old tombs from before my time. The dead down there don't stay down.$(br2)The Dead King sits on a throne at the heart of them. I went down once. I came back up a lot faster than I went in.
$(o)Gravediggers mutter that the Dead King guards the Undead Eye, deep in the Catacombs. A Wayward Compass knows the way.$()
